definitions.explanation: A wood made up of pine trees, often seen along the coast where pines are planted as windbreaks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{松林|まつばやし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: A pine grove stretches along the coast.

examples.japanese: {松林|まつばやし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}した→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: I took a walk through the pine woods.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{松林|まつばやし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{潮風|しおかぜ}→潮風：17591_shiokaze⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{植|う}えられた→植える：01210_ueru⟧。
examples.english: This pine grove was planted to protect the fields from the sea breeze.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{松|まつ}→松：02256_matsu⟧ (pine) + ⟦{林|はやし}→林：01702_hayashi⟧ (woods), with rendaku making it まつばやし. White-sand beaches lined with green pine groves ({白砂青松|はくしゃせいしょう}) are a classic image of the Japanese coast.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {松林|まつばやし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: a pine grove stretches on
- ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{松林|まつばやし}: a coastal pine grove
- {松林|まつばやし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧: pass through the pine woods
